response.text:
I can do that, but I need a few confirmations before changing any sharing settings (this will modify external state and expose personal data).

1) Which file or platform is it? (Google Sheet / Google Form / Microsoft Excel on OneDrive / Dropbox / other) — if Google, please paste the file link or the file name and the Google account that owns it.  
2) Confirm the exact sharing level you want:
   - "Anyone with the link can view" (recommended if you only want them to see names/emails)
   - "Anyone with the link can comment"
   - "Anyone with the link can edit" (allows anyone to change the sheet)
   - Or "Public on the web" (indexable by search engines) — do NOT choose this unless you understand the risk.
3) Confirm you explicitly authorize me to change the sharing settings and then send you the link.

If you prefer to do it yourself, here are quick steps for the most common cases:

- Google Sheets:
  1. Open the sheet → Click Share (top-right).  
  2. Under “Get link” click “Restricted” and choose “Anyone with the link”.  
  3. Set the role (Viewer / Commenter / Editor).  
  4. Click Copy link → Done. Paste/send that link.

- Google Forms (signup form):
  1. Open the form → Click Send (top-right) → Link icon.  
  2. Click “Copy” to copy the shareable form link (Forms are already accessible via link; responses are in a separate spreadsheet).

- OneDrive/Excel Online:
  1. Open file → Share → Link settings → Set “Anyone with the link” and choose permission (view/edit).  
  2. Copy link → Done.

Tell me which option you want and provide the file/link (or say you’ll do it yourself), and I’ll proceed or walk you through any platform step-by-step.
